text: Raja Chakraborty is a Senior Software Engineer with expertise in Java backend microservices, PySpark distributed data engineering, and AI systems. His career achievements include original high-throughput RoaringBitmap seat map implementations, IEEE Senior Membership recognition, EB-1A extraordinary ability petitioning in AI/systems engineering, and building sub-millisecond PII redaction proxies.

The real-time seat availability platform compresses 100,000 seat states per venue using RoaringBitmap sparse array representation. Encoded payloads are pushed over WebSockets to client browsers with zero-copy deserialization.
PromptShield provides deterministic sub-millisecond PII redaction for SSNs, Credit Cards, and API key tokens at the API gateway tier before prompts reach LLM model backends.

GCP Cloud Run v2 container services are configured with min_instance_count = 0 to scale to zero when idle, consuming zero compute budget while maintaining sub-second cold starts under peak concurrency.
The GCP Model Router analyzes prompt complexity heuristics to route architectural and code generation queries to Gemini 1.5 Pro, while directing standard summarization requests to Gemini 1.5 Flash.
